title: The correctness harness fingerprints the wrong runtime
spec: Spawned by T-6 (FINDINGS section 7). Every battery output prints 'runtime.sql sha256=<hash>' computed by hashing the FILE the harness expects (spikes/T-1/proto/runtime.sql) rather than the functions actually installed in the database. During T-6 that made all 42 battery outputs claim T-3's runtime while the database held T-6's patched one - the results were correct but the provenance line on every one of them was wrong. It was caught only because a probe was written specifically to check it (spikes/T-6/probes/P3_installed_fingerprint.py). Fix: fingerprint pg_get_functiondef over the installed xpr schema, not the file on disk, and print both when they disagree. Small change, high value - an evidence-integrity defect in the instrument that decides whether this project ships.
